summary: Harden worktree record validation and git selector isolation

delivery.outcome: Bring single-file operations/conformance.py below 500 lines, strip inherited GIT_* selectors in _git_output for registered_worktrees and resolve_primary_checkout, prevent AttributeError/TypeError crashes on malformed records, enforce repository and entry field types, and reject duplicate JSON keys and symlinked record inputs.
nonGoals: No breaking changes to wellmanifest.worktrees/v5 JSON Schema or standalone bundler compatibility.

architecture.decision: Keep operations/conformance.py self-contained below 500 lines so downstream bundlers (worktree_path_check.py) remain single-file compatible while hardening validation and GIT_* environment isolation.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-025 commit on main.

validation.evidence: Domain conformance tests, <500-line check, and governance checks pass.
